definitions.gloss: to hold tightly, to clutch, to hug closely
definitions.explanation: To wrap one's arms around something and hold it close to the body.

definitions.gloss: to take on alone, to shoulder by oneself, to bottle up
definitions.explanation: To take on problems, worries, or responsibilities without sharing them with others. Often implies keeping things to oneself when one should ask for help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}んで⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked while clutching the luggage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ぬいぐるみ→ぬいぐるみ：05289_nuigurumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child is hugging a big stuffed animal tightly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}んで⟦{離|はな}さなかった→離す：19372_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: She held the album tightly to her chest and wouldn't let go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}まないでほしい。
examples.english: I don't want you to keep your worries to yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}みすぎて⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}した→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧。
examples.english: He took on too much work and ruined his health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}まず、⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Rather than shouldering the problem alone, you should talk to someone about it.

notes:
{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む combines ⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to hold in one's arms) with ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into), creating an image of pulling something in close and keeping it there.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to clutch ~; to take on ~ alone
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to keep to oneself, to shoulder alone

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to bottle up one's worries
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to take on problems alone
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to take on too much work
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抱|かか}え{込|こ}む: to bear it alone

NOTE: The figurative sense (sense 2) is very commonly used in advice contexts, where people are told not to {抱|かか}え{込|こ}む problems.
